name: f2-pops-mini
why: F2 collapses the app to the mini line (play glyph, title · artist, time, thin bar) above the prompt; every panel but ask hides.

name: f2-twice-restores-layout-and-focus
why: F2 again brings back the same layout and gives focus back to the list it was on (the footer shows the list keys).

name: ctrl-p-is-f2
why: Laptops need Fn for F2: Ctrl+P does the same.

name: mini-fits-60x6
why: A 60x6 corner window holds the mini line and the prompt, nothing clipped.

name: tiny-window-shows-mini-on-its-own
why: When the window is too small for the player panel, the mini line stands in for it instead of the song vanishing.

name: tiny-window-mini-goes-when-it-grows
why: The automatic mini line goes away when the player fits again.

name: ctrl-up-volume
why: Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down change the volume from the prompt without typing into it.

name: ctrl-l-likes
why: Ctrl+L likes the song that's playing, like ♥.

name: ctrl-g-layout-picker
why: Ctrl+G opens the layout picker; a second Ctrl+T while it's open opens nothing on top.

name: f1-help-lists-the-keys
why: F1 opens help from the prompt (? there is just typed), and help lists every key.
expect: mini player: pop in, pop back out

name: empty-history-says-something
why: An empty tab says what fills it, centred, instead of 'nothing here'.
expect: no history yet · songs you play show up here
